description: A PHP class implementing a Drupal router with integrated access control checks, wrapping around Symfony routing components.

classes.name: AccessAwareRouter
classes.description: A Drupal-specific router class that adds access control checks to route matching, wrapping around Symfony's routing system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the router with Symfony routing, access manager, and user account.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying Symfony router.

methods.name: matchRequest
methods.description: Matches a request to a route and performs access check.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Performs access control check and throws exceptions if access is denied.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a URL for a route.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Creates a request from a path and matches it to a route, with access check.
